rows.title: This retention chart hack will get you more views #shorts
rows.description:
This is how you use retention charts to get more views on your content.

Every organic video is gonna look something like this...

Big drop off in the first 5 seconds and then a smooth level off.

If your video is really bad, that cliff will be much sharper and go much lower.

If your video is really good, you’ll still have a cliff, but it won’t be as sharp and will level off much higher.

The steepness of that cliff corresponds to skip rate.

Anything above 50% is bad, between 30-50% is good, less than 30% is elite.

But none of that is really that actionable.

Here’s the magic tip.

Occasionally, you will get a retention chart that has a spike somewhere along the graph.

And that spike is gold.

What the spike means that less people dropped off than should have because of whatever you said or showed at the time.

You wanna look at exactly where in the video that spike happened, and extract that point, that sentence, that concept, or those visuals out…and use it in the hook on a future video.

This is called Retention Hunting.

These are little hidden gems that you accidentally buried too late in the video, but that the data is showing people liked.

If you go through your videos and find these hidden gems, I guarantee these will make for winning videos on their own.
